# BuildX

> > AI-powered construction cost intelligence platform with 2,182 trade calculators, contractor matching, and automation tools for the construction industry.

BuildX provides real-time construction cost data, AI-driven estimating tools, and contractor matching services designed for homeowners and construction professionals. The platform combines cost intelligence with automation features like AI call answering and smart scheduling to streamline construction project management.

## Core Platform

- [BuildX Homepage](https://buildx.pro): AI-powered construction cost estimates with 2,182 calculators and contractor matching.

- [About BuildX](https://buildx.pro/contractor/about): Company mission to serve contractors with AI-powered tools and construction intelligence from the field.
